provenance: Factual NFL public Flashscore odds subsets and corresponding Polymarket resolution descriptions. Captured once per event, no synthetic odds.

source_rules.description:
In the upcoming NFL game, scheduled for September 27 at 1:00PM ET:
If Chargers wins, the market will resolve to "Chargers".
If Bills wins, the market will resolve to "Bills".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
If the game is canceled entirely or ends in a tie, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

source_rules.description:
In the first half of the NFL game between Chargers and Bills, scheduled for September 27 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Chargers and Bills combine to score 20 or more points in the first half.

If the combined first half total is less than 20, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
